variants.A: Original design for an anti-gravity arcade racing game (not based on any existing game). A sleek wedge-shaped hover racer in cobalt blue and white with cyan glowing seams, a long pointed nose, two swept-back side pods ending in big round glowing thrusters, a small bubble canopy, short delta fins. No wheels: it hovers. Stylized clean hard-surface model, glossy painted panels with thin glowing neon seams, Tron and Ready Player One cyberpunk flavour. Isolated on a pure white background, the whole machine in frame with margin, three-quarter front view from slightly above, soft even studio light, no text, no logos, no numbers, no driver visible, no shadow clutter.
